text.tspan: --- SESSION RESTORE on app boot (AuthContext useEffect) ---
--- PASSWORD RESET (dev mode returns the token) ---
LEGACY FALLBACK - if an RPC is missing (PGRST202), the client falls
back to the original flow: sha256(password) check against users.password_hash
and a JSON session snapshot in "eventflow_session_legacy".

svg.text: throw "Rate limit exceeded. Try again in..."
error "Too many attempts. Please try again later."
verify password (bcrypt crypt() or legacy sha256)
clear auth_attempts then load profile + role
token = crypto.randomUUID() then device name from user-agent
reject if email exists ("Email already in use")
bcrypt hash (gen_salt bf 10) then insert users + attendee profile
find device_sessions by token then update last_active_at
check suspended then load profile + role (device_session_id)
invalidate old unused tokens then create token (24 random bytes)
validate: unused, not expired, length 6 or more
bcrypt hash new password then mark token used
delete ALL device_sessions for the user (force re-login)
